- When sentiment is positive (≥0.5) and forecast is high, reduce forecast by 5–10% to avoid overestimation.  
- After a sharp price spike (e.g., >10% from prior day), model tends to overshoot; cap forecast at 10% above prior peak.  
- If sentiment is negative (≤-0.5) and forecast is low, add 3–5% to avoid underestimation.  
- Model consistently overpredicts early in the 30-day horizon; apply a 2–3 day lag correction by subtracting 1–2% per day from forecast.  
- Mean reversion is strong in 10–15 day windows; if forecast is >15% above 10-day moving average, reduce by 5–8%.  
- If sentiment history shows repeated “1.0” (strong bullish) followed by sharp drop, expect 3–5 day correction; adjust forecast downward by 3–7% in next 3 days.
